requirements.detail: Compile one bounded typed draft into deterministic proposal artifacts.

source_refs.quote: Create a bounded typed workshop plan.

requirements.detail: Keep source assertions and completion claims explicitly unverified.

milestones.title: Contract
milestones.outcome: A typed and strictly validated planning graph exists.

boundary: Configured count and byte limits are enforced.

milestones.title: Projection
milestones.outcome: All four draft proposal artifacts share one canonical graph.

positive: Every step is cross-linked in each relevant projection.
negative: No projection claims acceptance or execution.
boundary: All generated files remain within artifact byte limits.

steps.title: Render proposal artifacts
steps.detail: Derive canonical JSON and three Markdown projections from the normalized graph.
actions: Render canonical plan JSON from normalized data.

expected_outputs.description: One canonical JSON file and three Markdown proposal files.

positive: A second compile of plan.json has the same digest.
negative: Rendered text does not claim source verification.
boundary: Generated output stays below the configured byte ceiling.

steps.title: Review contract limits
steps.detail: Review the conservative first-version bounds before adapter expansion.
actions: Record any proposed policy changes for review.

expected_outputs.description: A review note about the conservative graph bounds.

positive: Every exported limit has an exact-boundary test.
negative: No review note changes runtime policy automatically.
boundary: The review covers the maximum collection sizes.

steps.title: Validate the graph
steps.detail: Reject ambiguous JSON, invalid references, uncovered requirements, and dependency cycles.
actions: Inspect every typed reference against the draft graph.
Confirm positive, negative, and boundary acceptance cases are present.

expected_outputs.description: A structurally valid draft result requiring review.

boundary: The exact input byte limit is accepted.
